summary: The children of Israel press forward to their promised land—They pass through the lands of Esau and of Ammon in peace but destroy the Amorites.
meta_description: The children of Israel press forward to their promised land—They pass through the lands of Esau and of Ammon in peace but destroy the Amorites.

footnotes.note3_a: HEB gone around this mountain region, or hill country.
footnotes.note10_b: IE an ancient race of large people; sometimes translated as “giants” (also vv. 11, 21).
footnotes.note14_c: HEB had perished from the camp.
footnotes.note23_b: IE Crete, from which early Philistines (Caphtorim) migrated to Canaan.
footnotes.note28_c: HEB let me pass through on foot.
